crossRefs.note: What is my strength, that I should wait? What is my end, that I should be patient?
If I had called, and he had answered me, yet I wouldn’t believe that he listened to my voice.
While he was still talking with them, behold, the messenger came down to him. Then he said, “Behold, this evil is from…
They will pass through it, very distressed and hungry. It will happen that when they are hungry, they will worry, and…
and look to the earth, and see distress, darkness, and the gloom of anguish. They will be driven into thick darkness.
He threw down the pieces of silver in the sanctuary, and departed. He went away and hanged himself.
He will flee from the iron weapon. The bronze arrow will strike him through.
He draws it out, and it comes out of his body. Yes, the glittering point comes out of his liver. Terrors are on him.

translations.web: He doesn’t believe that he will return out of darkness. He is waited for by the sword.
translations.bsb: He despairs of his return from darkness; he is marked for the sword.
translations.kjv: He believeth not that he shall return out of darkness, and he is waited for of the sword.
translations.asv: He believeth not that he shall return out of darkness, And he is waited for of the sword.
